newsitem.title: USA: North America bunkers mixed, demand strong in L.A..
newsitem.headline: North America bunkers mixed, demand strong in L.A..

text.p: North American bunker prices were mixed on Thursday as the end of the holidays brought back buyers on the West Coast, upping demand in Los Angeles.
Players said about 20,000 tonnes of bunkers were done in Los Angeles, although prices did not go up until one supplier willing to sell at lower values stepped back.
Spot Los Angeles 380 CST was up $5 to between $120 and $123 a tonne, with 180 CST holding steady at $123/125, players said.
Seattle was quiet amid a glut of product, pushing 380 CST down about $4 to $118/120.
